name: English
title: Open CAD Studio — Free DWG & DXF CAD
description: Open and save DWG and DXF, draft in 2D and model in 3D. Free, open-source CAD for your browser and Windows, Linux and macOS.
hero_lead: Draw in 2D, create layouts and model in 3D. Work in your browser or on your desktop, and save drawings to your device.
no_account: Web app: free · No account · No installation
workspace_alt: A DWG technical plan open in the Open CAD Studio workspace
cap_title: From the first line to the final layout.
cap_lead: Commands, precise placement and drawing sheets in one workspace.
draft_text: Draw and edit with command autocomplete, object snaps and tracking. Organize your drawing with layers, blocks and external references.
doc_text: Add text, dimensions, leaders, tolerances and tables. Arrange paper-space layouts with viewports and plot styles.
open_text: Open and save native DWG and DXF files on your device. The source code is public and the tools are free to use.
model_text: Create primitives, extrude, revolve, sweep and loft. Combine or subtract solids with Boolean operations handled by the geometry kernel.
model_alt: A 3D mechanical model in two Open CAD Studio viewports
editions_label: One core, two ways to work
editions_title: Open in your browser or install on your desktop.
web_text: Use the web app without an account or installation. Open a drawing from your device, edit it and download the result.
web_limit: For large drawings and native integrations, use the desktop app.
desktop_text: Use file associations, thumbnails, system printing, PDF output, native plugins, scripts and headless automation.
formats_title: Open and save drawing files directly.
formats_text: Open and save DWG and DXF directly, with save targets from R14 to 2018. Work with recovery files, meshes and property exports too.
growth_text: Follow the project through GitHub stars and release downloads.
faq_free_answer: Yes. The project is open source and distributed under the GPL-3.0 license.
faq_web: Do I need an account or installation?
faq_web_answer: No. Open the web app in a modern browser. Drawings are opened from your device and saved as local downloads.
faq_platforms_answer: Packages are available for Windows, Linux and Apple Silicon macOS.
faq_production: Can I use it for critical production files?
faq_production_answer: The project is under active development. Keep backups and report reproducible problems on GitHub.
community_text: Report issues, contribute code or support development.
footer: Open-source technical drawing and solid modeling.
